requirement_text: The system shall provide a mobile football application for Android devices.
requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."

user_story.user_story:
As an Android user, I want to use the football app on my device so that I can access football content on the go.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I use an Android device
When I install and open the app
Then I can access the football app and use its features.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a mobile football application for iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."

user_story.user_story:
As an iOS user, I want to use the football app on my device so that I can access football content on the go.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I use an iOS device
When I install and open the app
Then I can access the football app and use its features.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to view current football news for their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams"

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to view current news about my favorite teams so that I can stay informed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have selected one or more favorite teams
When I navigate to the news section
Then I see current football news related to my favorite teams.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to individually select preferred sports channels for news content.
requirement_reference: "and also select preferred sports channels individually."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to choose my preferred sports channels so that I receive news from sources I trust.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given channel preferences are available
When I select one or more preferred sports channels
Then the app stores my preferences and uses them to tailor displayed news.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a live ticker for users to follow live results of their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to follow my favorite teams via a live ticker so that I can track live match results.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have selected favorite teams
When a match involving a favorite team is live
Then I can open a live ticker and see current live results.

requirement_text: The system shall provide coverage of national leagues and competitions.
requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want access to national league and competition coverage so that I can follow domestic football.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given national leagues and competitions are supported
When I browse competitions in the app
Then I can view information and content for national leagues and competitions.

requirement_text: The system shall provide coverage of international leagues and competitions.
requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want access to international league and competition coverage so that I can follow global football.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given international leagues and competitions are supported
When I browse competitions in the app
Then I can view information and content for international leagues and competitions.

requirement_text: The system shall provide detailed team information at any time.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to view detailed team information so that I can learn more about teams.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given team data exists
When I open a team profile
Then I can view detailed information about the selected team.

requirement_text: The system shall provide detailed player information at any time.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to view detailed player information so that I can learn more about players.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given player data exists
When I open a player profile
Then I can view detailed information about the selected player.

requirement_text: The system shall display live stream links in the app when a live broadcast has begun.
requirement_reference: "Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to see live stream links in the app when broadcasts start so that I can access live match coverage quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a supported live broadcast has started
When I view the relevant match in the app
Then I see the available live stream link directly in the app.

requirement_text: The system shall display live stream links only when transmission rights are valid in the user's country.
requirement_reference: "Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want stream links to respect regional rights so that I only see streams legally available in my country.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live stream exists for a match
And transmission rights are not fulfilled in my country
When I view the match in the app
Then the live stream link is not displayed.
Given a live stream exists for a match
And transmission rights are fulfilled in my country
When I view the match in the app
Then the live stream link is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves and displays live data in real time.
requirement_reference: "To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to retrieve and display live ticker data in real time so that I can follow match events as they happen.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live match is in progress
When I open the live ticker
Then live match data is retrieved and displayed in real time.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to access app information directly through the user interface.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want direct access to information through the interface so that I can find content quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am using the app
When I navigate through the interface
Then I can directly access available information without unnecessary steps.

requirement_text: The system shall display and manage various app modules through the user interface.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want app modules to be accessible in one interface so that I can use the app consistently.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given multiple modules exist in the app
When I use the user interface
Then the modules are displayed together and can be managed through the interface.

requirement_text: The live ticker module shall communicate with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data.
requirement_reference: "The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the live ticker to continuously update match data in the interface so that I always see the latest information.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live match is active
When current match data changes
Then the live ticker updates the displayed match data through the interface.

requirement_text: The system shall retrieve live data for the live ticker via an API from an external server.
requirement_reference: "The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want live ticker data to be sourced from an external server so that live information can be dynamically updated.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the external live data API is available
When the live ticker requests match data
Then the app retrieves the data from the external server API.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to individually configure the app through additional modules.
requirement_reference: "In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want configurable app modules so that I can personalize how the app works for me.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given configurable modules are available
When I change module settings
Then the app saves and applies my individual configuration.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a notification function that informs users about current events when activated.
requirement_reference: "Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to receive notifications about current events when I enable notifications so that I stay updated.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have activated notifications
When a relevant current event occurs
Then I receive a notification in the app or on my device.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to register directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.user_story:
As a new user, I want to register when I start the app so that I can begin using personalized features immediately.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am a new user opening the app
When I choose to register at startup
Then I can complete registration directly from the startup flow.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to log in directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.user_story:
As a returning user, I want to log in when I start the app so that I can access my account quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am a returning user opening the app
When I choose to log in at startup
Then I can complete login directly from the startup flow.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to follow favorite clubs.
requirement_reference: "Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to follow my favorite clubs so that the app can personalize content for me.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given club profiles are available
When I mark one or more clubs as favorites
Then the app stores those clubs as my favorites.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to receive notifications about news related to their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want notifications about news for my favorite teams so that I do not miss important updates.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I follow one or more favorite teams
And notifications are activated
When news about a favorite team is published
Then I receive a notification about that news.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to receive notifications about results related to their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want notifications about results for my favorite teams so that I stay updated on match outcomes.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I follow one or more favorite teams
And notifications are activated
When a result for a favorite team is available
Then I receive a notification about that result.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to share news directly from the app via social media.
requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to share news on social media directly from the app so that I can easily post updates with others.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing a news item
When I choose the share option
Then I can share the news item via supported social media channels.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to share game reports directly from the app via social media.
requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want to share game reports on social media directly from the app so that I can easily post match information with others.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing a game report
When I choose the share option
Then I can share the game report via supported social media channels.

requirement_text: The system shall remain usable offline when network connectivity is temporarily lost.
requirement_reference: "The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to remain usable when I lose connectivity so that I can still access available features.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have previously opened the app with network access
When the device temporarily loses connection
Then the app remains usable offline for available features.

requirement_text: The system shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.
requirement_reference: "In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality."

user_story.user_story:
As a product team member, I want user feedback and app reviews to be evaluated continuously so that the app can be improved over time.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given user feedback and app reviews are collected
When evaluation activities are performed
Then the findings can be used to inform functionality improvements.
